verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI provides Docker/FastAPI deployment, resume checkpoints, and community mentions of bridging to automation tools like n8n and MCP servers, suggesting it can be embedded into autonomous background pipelines, but there is no first-party evidence of a native scheduler, trigger system, or persistent autonomous agent loop within Crawl4AI itself. missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger mechanism, documented autonomous background-run feature, first-party (non-community) evidence of persistent unattended operation, integration guide owned by Crawl4AI rather than third-party community sites.
